January 22, 2026 - There’s so much to see and do in this city, but here is my list of things you must see when visiting Lisbon for the first time. 15 incredible things to do in Lisbon: Your Ultimate City Guide
1 month ago - Be sure to stop into the former Jewish Quarter of the city, which after WWII was transformed into a centre for Lisbon’s bars and cool cafe culture. You’ll find plenty of incredible food in the area. Also did you know that bagels were actually invented in this neighbourhood?! Wild! I’d also recommend popping into a few of the bookstores while you’re at it. There are plenty to wander into for browsing. If you have time on your travels, I also recommend booking a half day to visit both Auschwitz and the Salt Mines.
